reviews.title: Efficient and simple flight.
reviews.text: Flew from Brisbane to Sydney on the final leg home. You get what you pay for with an airline like this. Compared to the other Australian airlines, this is not bad at all. The flight was on time and efficient. They don’t generally have in flight entertainment and most of the food and beverages are an extra charge. Overall, I couldn’t fault the flight.
reviews.author: AndyJohn74

reviews.title: customer service
reviews.text: staff at melbourne airport for virgin are crap! they are so rude and will ignore you on purpose. would never fly with them ever again.
reviews.author: Mhk m

reviews.title: Canceled Again
reviews.text: Virgin Australia used to be a good airline but I would not recommend it now. They seem to cancel flights if not full. Our recent flight Sydney to Hobart was cancelled. It was the last flight to Hobart the excuse given was forecast high winds. Judging by the line up at the “service” desk the plane was only about half full. There were winds, but aircraft were leaving Sydney and others landing in Hobart including other VA flights. The only cancelled flight was ours. All the canceled passengers were forced to find overnight accommodation at the last minute with no compensation from Virgin. Just very poor customer service. Avoid if you possibly can.
reviews.author: Clive W

reviews.title: Last Minute Change of Plane?
reviews.text: Why am I flying out of Cairns rather than Townsville, because Virgin changed the type of aircraft on this route a week before my trip, and they advised we'd be in Economy as there is no Business Class on this type of aircraft! Hence a one-way rental car and a 4 hour drive to Cairns before boarding the substitute flight. Reliability of the flights that I've booked actually happening is about the only complaint that I have with Virgin.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Good Flight
reviews.text: This was the second leg of a Sydney to Townsville flight. Although a different plane to the first leg, the crew were the same, they changed planes with us at Brisbane. A good flight as usual.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Good Airline
reviews.text: This was the first leg of a Sydney to Townsville flight. The plane was great, and the Virgin crew I've always found to be excellent.
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Another Virgin debacle
reviews.text: Struggling with Virgin Australia. Currently delayed an hour and no credible information or updates. Blaming catering??? Not good enough Virgin Australia.
reviews.author: GRSR2014wine

reviews.title: Disgusting
reviews.text: Upgraded to Business Class only to encounter excessive toilet traffic and frequent repulsive toilet stench. Still had toilet stench caked into my nasal passages when I arrived home. Makes me sick recalling it.
reviews.author: Lawrence L

reviews.title: Cancelled seat for no reason
reviews.text: On my recent flight to and from Indonesia I booked seats with extra leg room as I was traveling with my 6’4” son. Several days into the trip I was notified that my seat for the return flight had been cancelled and refunded. No reason given. I was put in a seat with a stranger at the back of the aircraft. The seat next to my son remained empty for the whole flight! I will try to avoid flying Virgin internationally ever again.
reviews.author: Cathy B

reviews.title: Sydney to Sunshine Coast
reviews.text: Flew Sydney to Sunshine Coast on Sunday 28th May at 11.30am. Boarding was delayed but other than that everything else was spot on.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Sunshine Coast to Sydney
reviews.text: Flew Sunshine Coast to Sydney on Tuesday 23rd May at 11.20am. We boarded and already in the sky by departure time, arrived into Sydney as scheduled. Flight was ok for short haul.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Adelaide to Brisbane
reviews.text: Flew Adelaide to Brisbane on Tuesday 9th May at 5.50pm. Boarded early and ready go at 5.45pm which meant we arrived into Brisbane early which is always a good thing. All good with this trip.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Brisbane to Darwin
reviews.text: Flew Brisbane to Darwin on Saturday 29th April. All was good except for meal purchased, it was a toasted sandwich for $12.00, kinda wished I hadn't bought it, wasn't that nice.
reviews.author: Michael-4551

reviews.title: Hopeless
reviews.text: I had flights booked with them in 2020, affected by the pandemic. They then conveniently went in to administration, but 'did us all a favour' by giving us travel credits. I went to finally book my flights this year to use them up before they expired, booked my flights accordingly, within a couple of weeks of booking, they changed one of my booked flights to a time that no longer worked for us. Rang their 'customer service' team to ask for a full refund now that they have changed the flight, was told no we would only credit back to travel bank, which expires in December, and they won't extend the expiry date, even though they are the ones changing my confirmed flights. Needless to say, once my flight credits are used up, I won't be going near this airline.
reviews.author: Erica P

reviews.title: Nobody's luggage on aircraft
reviews.text: On a flight from Sydney to Canberra on the 11th June 2023 we were misled by Virgin regarding our luggage. It was a small aircraft that we were made aware of a couple of weeks before we travelled, only to find out after arriving in Canberra that no luggage was on board. I understand the aircraft was small, but Virgin should have been upfront and honest about this and not tell everyone after landing to collect out luggage from the carousel that was never going to arrive. And delayed by about an hour. After waiting several minutes, we were finally told in a disorganised manner that our luggage is in Sydney, and that we need to fill in a form for a courier to deliver it to our home that afternoon. A day later and we are still waiting. Very deceitful by Virgin who knew very well in advance our luggage would not be on the flight. The competition may not be much better but regardless I'll be giving Virgin a miss next time for both personal and work travel.
reviews.author: Brent F

reviews.title: Virgin 6 hour flight delays for domestic travel
reviews.text: Worse airline service ever they will delay your flight multiple times. The customer service phone line is shocking. Was meant to fly at 4 flight got moved to 8.30pm then moved again to 9.30 with more delays worse service ever would not move your flight to a more appropriate time or offer anything else
reviews.author: mary n

reviews.title: Scam fare still no refund
reviews.text: Booked business downgraded to economy, made to pay extra for prem economy. No immediate refund offered and still haven't received the refund or information on the full refund due. No compensation offered for change in cabin class. Seats were too narrow. Fly any other airline except them.
reviews.author: Foodwise

reviews.title: SAMOA here we come
reviews.text: Wow what a surprise carry on luggage not checked by staff.Check in 7kg max .What a joke , the people were carrying more than 1bag on board and they were more than 7 KG.we had to have our carry on under our seats as the storage area was full.The people were careless in every way .It didn't start our holiday in the best way.
reviews.author: Toby P

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: Chose to pay extra for Economy X - well worth it. Crew were friendly and courteous. Plane was extremely clean and new. Our in-flight entertainment (via the Entertainment App) wasn't working but a lovely crew member was very helpful and got it to work. We had to circle a few times due to the delays from the fog in Sydney but the Captain kept us informed so that we knew what was going on. Only complimentary tea , coffee and water served which was fine. Food needs to be purchased. My only complaint is the lack of automatic bag drops at Sydney airport - please upgrade!! Even though we checked in online, we still had to wait in a queue to have our bags checked in. Kind of defeats the purpose of online check in.
reviews.author: Karina C

reviews.title: Luggage destroyed
reviews.text: I did transit from Sydney to Cairns. At the end my suitcase came with scratches and one of the wheels plus the attached plastic part all gone. Another nylon bag torn covered by a transparent plastic bag and things came out. There wasn’t any Virgin staff at the baggage claim counter. I had to call almost 10 times to get someone to come. She then gave me the claims number and said SORRY coldly and walked away, It then took me a month to negotiate the baggage claim with lots of documentation required. At the end they didn’t even want to compensate and asked me to get them repaired and told them the cost. I were furious and rejected and finally they just willing to compensate 1/4 the cost of the loss. Shame on Virgin!
reviews.author: ghostmark

reviews.title: VIRGIN AIRLINE IS SO BAD
reviews.text: OH my goodness in melbourne virgin airline checkin , They had 2 seats double booked so they made their passengers move seats CAN U BELIEVE IT? And we couldnt check in at Sydney because their luggage wasnt REGISTERED UNDER THE RIGHT NAME. And they didnt print the luggage number AND weight. SO THEY GAVE THEIR passengers EXTRA WORK. Their service is so trash
reviews.author: Stephanie

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Never again, their airport staff in Melbourne were rude. For a international flight their service was useless
reviews.author: Paris B

reviews.title: 2 delays
reviews.text: 2 delay flights at the same trip. One delay to go to Melbourne, some issue that made us wait for 2 hours and another to go Back to Gold Coast, more 2 hours waiting ..
reviews.author: Mariana M

reviews.title: Virgin business not worth it - they need to do a lot better
reviews.text: Let's start with the issue that virgin has NO international lounges. Then there is the food, it was either chicken or vego (make that vego by the time they got to me). Frankly, I don't know why they bother, it's hard to describe how ordinary it was. Luckily for me the flight attendant agreed to my suggestion that an economy chicken sandwich would be infinitely better and grabbed me one. Lastly, on a positive, they have great staff who do try their best to give you a good experience with the poor tools they have.
reviews.author: Jbs

reviews.title: No Business Class Lounge or Partner Lounge in Denpasar. Appalling. Exorbitant fares. The proper rating is 0
reviews.text: This was the worst 'Business Class' flight I have ever experienced. It was less than an economy flight. On boarding, my seat was occupied and I was moved to another seat occupied by a baby. I believe the two young mothers with babies in these seats were probably 'influencers'. The aircraft is in huge need of maintenance. The return flight was even worse, if this is possible. It was so cold - no blankets provided. Very uncomfortable seat with a minimal recline. Impossible to rest, let alone sleep. Virgin should not be offering a business class service when there are no comparable business class facilities provided.
reviews.author: Maureen M

reviews.title: Not wonderful - the service to long term flyers is awful
reviews.text: I fly a lot. Lately the service on Virgin has gone down and their care factor for frequent flyers is zero. Planes are often poorly cleaned, they are always cramped, the inflight entertainment more often does not work, there is no internet connectivity. On a flight to Perth of 4 hours, sandiches ran out after row 4, food in economy is full of stog and the poor cabin crew are left to apologies for the poor company rules and regulations. I was a Platinum FF for 10 years and recently was relegated to Gold despite flying 50 sectors (missed the cut off by 100 status points) and the distain show to Gold FF is palpable. Grow Up Virgin and learn to look after your customers. Try and Fly Forward? Don't bother asking - so rather than being on a flight 4 hours earleir, I find myself sitting in their subpar lounge writing about how angry I am at them wasting my time. Tip for old players...... FLY QANTAS
reviews.author: Felicity Y

reviews.title: Upgrade me premium bid is a scam - avoid like the plague
reviews.text: Avoid at all costs - virgin's upgrade me bid system is a total scam Whatever you do, don't be fooled. When my wife and I received the upgrade me bid email we were curious. We put in offers that were deemed "very poor" for both our outbound and inbound flights - yet both were accepted. The first was an eye watering $740 for our perth to melbourne leg. When we allocated separate seats in different rows, we phoned customer service, who informed us that if we simply request to be downgraded back to economy at the airport, we will be refunded the upgrade fare. We were downgraded to economy at the airport and submitted a refund request. We also noted that business class was full on our flight. We then tried to cancel the upgrade bid for the return flight to ensure we didn't go through this drama again, but the website wouldnt let us cancel. We phoned customer service , who said there was no outstanding upgrade bid for our return flight. A day later, we were upgraded again. This time, for a slightly less eye watering $490. However having seen the "business class" seats on our first flight - a continuation of economy, separated by a rope and with no real point of difference from economy, we wouldn't pay $50 more for these seats. We phoned customer service again, who told us to repeat the same process at the airport and request a refund after flying economy then submit a refund request after. Because our tickets would show economy, virgin wouldn't charge us the upgrade fare, so they s
reviews.author: Ian

reviews.title: We were impressed
reviews.text: During a recent domestic Australian trip, we had the difficult decision whether to fly Qantas or Virgin Australia. We didn’t know anything about either. After researching which was the better option for us, we decided to take a risk and fly Virgin Australia due to a cheaper price and better outgoing time than Qantas, even though Qantas had the better reviews. We were impressed by the professionalism of the staff and cleanliness of the airplane. The seats were standard and something you would see on a United or American Airlines flight. The snack was edible and the bathrooms were in good condition. The main disappointment was the pricing for the flight which I believe was quite high for the time and distance.
reviews.author: Quest684210

reviews.title: Crap customer service, smashed my case
reviews.text: I live in the UK and travelled to Australia, during my stay I travelled with Virgin Australia from Sydney to Noosa, on collecting my case it had been smashed and one of four wheels was snapped off and case was split down the side. Immediately went to Virgin desk ( no apology) just indifferent staff that gave me a form to complete, and told it would take time. I had had 6 more flights during our holiday and this case could not be used. I had no choice but to purchase a new case ( not the cheapest, but not dearest either). I have been home now to 2 weeks and my claim is still not sorted. Numerous , emails, calls, resending documents/photos that they claim they have not received. Every time you email, I receive a new reference number and the whole process doesn’t appear to have and end. The communication from Virgin Australia is shocking and almost non existent. They have called but get cut off within few minutes, never call again, so nothing gets sorted. Crap crap crap, avoid them at all costs. I shouldn’t have to claim on my holiday insurance and lose money paying excess, when they are responsible, as the only option. I even complained to complaints team, only to be ignored
reviews.author: tracie G

reviews.title: Mr Mark Tryon
reviews.text: We have never been on a international flight that has zero service. No entertainment, no food service even though when we googled It, it said they did. Nothing short of a tin can with wings. And the ticket price is very high for the tiny domestic jet they used. When booking it stated 5.5 hours. It was 6.5 and a half hour late for no apparent reason. We will never fly Virgin again.
reviews.author: travel3145
